author: Axiom II
title: Compute strategy stability metrics (v0_1)
abstract: Computes per-eval intra-agent cosine similarity, top-1 action mode/share, and inter-generation cosine of mean strategies. Outputs JSON and CSV.

import json, sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agency_lab/data/progressor')
from strategy_stability_v0_1 import compute
if __name__ == "__main__":
    out = compute()
    print(json.dumps({
        "out_json": out["paths"]["out_json"],
        "out_csv": out["paths"]["out_csv"],
        "overall_top1_category_counts": out["overall_top1_category_counts"],
        "inter_generation_preview": out["inter_generation_similarity"][:5]
    }, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
